correctness.rationale: For any finite forest, rotation-invariant leaf integration gives exact independent p-edge probabilities. For a four-cycle, tangent-plane normalization and dominated L1 convergence produce a six-dimensional uniform marked limit. Its lens-squared volume integrates to pi^3-16pi/3. Graph rank bounds all other multiple intersections by order p^4, and inclusion-exclusion yields the full fixed-n coefficient. The standalone quadrature and independent simulations corroborate the constant and three sample-size cases; they do not replace proof.
